recommendation: Keep the fix. It preserves FHIR-7754 through later approved workflow refactors and avoids reintroducing the removed reasonNotPerformed extension or notDone boolean.
issue_request: FHIR-7754 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and asked for a way to capture reasons a requested action was not performed. The final resolution put this in the Event pattern by adding notDone, reasonNotDone, and usage notes for explicit statements that something was not done.
initial_application: The seed was initially applied by 839bf586d6c1cf9a322e122852f0cc49bcfed263, which explicitly listed #7754 in a workflow-alignment commit and added the original Event notDone/notDoneReason approach.
additional_context: Later Published workflow decisions FHIR-13457 and FHIR-13907 collapsed Event.notDone into the not-done status and made statusReason subsume notDoneReason. FHIR-14063 synchronized Communication to statusReason, FHIR-12766 preserved the Communication not-done reason binding, and FHIR-13306/FHIR-13346 removed the redundant reasonNotPerformed extension; those related issues are already represented on the combined branch or used only as context.
reconciliation: Changed source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml to replace the stale notDoneReason constraint with a current Event.reason constraint for status not-done, update the XPath/FHIRPath from reasonCode/reasonReference to reason, and update comments to reason/reason.concept.text. Changed Communication.statusReason guidance and its mapping exception to refer to Communication.reason.
